Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. **Software Engineer, Infrastructure**
=====================================

**Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) · $185K–$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits**

**About Sodalis**
-----------------

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.  
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.  
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.
* Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.
* Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.
* Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.
* Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.
* You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.
* You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.
* You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.
* You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.
* You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

**How we work**
---------------

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

Compensation Range: $185K - $215K

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Generative UI, Input Experience
jobs.description:
A generated interface is only as good as the pieces it's made from. Give a model the wrong pieces and it fails, producing something generic or broken. Give it the right ones and it can make something a designer would be proud of.  
  
We're looking for an engineer with a designer's eye to build those pieces: the views, layouts, and APIs that generated interfaces are built from. The goal is to make the right result the easy one to write, for people and models.  
  
**Description**  
  
You'll join a small, newly formed team working closely with Apple's design studio, and you'll own the UI layer that generative interfaces are built on. Your APIs will have two kinds of users: engineers, and the models generating interfaces in real time. Most of the work is finding the right abstraction. Which layout decisions should a view make by itself? Which should be stated as intent? Which should never be exposed at all? An API that answers those questions well lets a model write a few lines and get something that feels native.  
  
The hard cases are the ones designers usually solve by hand: tight space, many sizes, content whose length and shape aren't known until it arrives. You'll build components that handle them without anyone drawing each one.  
  
With designers, you'll prototype quickly until something feels right, then turn it into a principled, well-named API with a small surface. With the generation side, you'll study how models use your APIs and change them until good results are the default. Along the way you'll partner with design, AI, and UI framework teams across Apple.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience designing framework API: naming, progressive disclosure, defaults  
  
Experience building adaptive layouts that stay correct with content that isn't known ahead of time  
  
Deep knowledge of Dynamic Type, accessibility, localization, and right-to-left layout  
  
Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library used across many product teams  
  
Experience designing APIs or schemas that a model generates against  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
5+ years of software engineering experience  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience  
  
Expert-level SwiftUI, including custom Layout and preferences, with a deep understanding of its layout model  
  
Designed and shipped a reusable view or component API that other engineers adopted  
  
A portfolio, shipped work, or prototypes that show strong visual craft, especially typography and layout  
  
Comfortable working directly with designers, from early ambiguous exploration through to a pixel-exact result

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Generative UI, Input Experience
new_jobs.description:
A generated interface is only as good as the pieces it's made from. Give a model the wrong pieces and it fails, producing something generic or broken. Give it the right ones and it can make something a designer would be proud of.  
  
We're looking for an engineer with a designer's eye to build those pieces: the views, layouts, and APIs that generated interfaces are built from. The goal is to make the right result the easy one to write, for people and models.  
  
**Description**  
  
You'll join a small, newly formed team working closely with Apple's design studio, and you'll own the UI layer that generative interfaces are built on. Your APIs will have two kinds of users: engineers, and the models generating interfaces in real time. Most of the work is finding the right abstraction. Which layout decisions should a view make by itself? Which should be stated as intent? Which should never be exposed at all? An API that answers those questions well lets a model write a few lines and get something that feels native.  
  
The hard cases are the ones designers usually solve by hand: tight space, many sizes, content whose length and shape aren't known until it arrives. You'll build components that handle them without anyone drawing each one.  
  
With designers, you'll prototype quickly until something feels right, then turn it into a principled, well-named API with a small surface. With the generation side, you'll study how models use your APIs and change them until good results are the default. Along the way you'll partner with design, AI, and UI framework teams across Apple.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience designing framework API: naming, progressive disclosure, defaults  
  
Experience building adaptive layouts that stay correct with content that isn't known ahead of time  
  
Deep knowledge of Dynamic Type, accessibility, localization, and right-to-left layout  
  
Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library used across many product teams  
  
Experience designing APIs or schemas that a model generates against  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
5+ years of software engineering experience  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience  
  
Expert-level SwiftUI, including custom Layout and preferences, with a deep understanding of its layout model  
  
Designed and shipped a reusable view or component API that other engineers adopted  
  
A portfolio, shipped work, or prototypes that show strong visual craft, especially typography and layout  
  
Comfortable working directly with designers, from early ambiguous exploration through to a pixel-exact result

The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Launched in 2001 as the tech arm of Major League Baseball, MLB.com is renowned for creating experiences that baseball fans love, and by embracing modern, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-augmented development practices, we're building the future of sports technology faster than ever. Our BACE organization distributes content from our Content Management System (CMS) to MLB, MiLB, and other operated properties. This includes managing the publishing pipelines for news, videos, and push notifications, as well as services that support sitemap generation, search functionality, and cache busting. Additionally, we support internal tools that enable digital producers to create and manage forms for both MLB and MiLB Clubs. We also maintain a tool for managing player photo uploads, marketing materials, walk-up songs, and vanity redirects. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with other world-class engineers, product developers, and designers; contribute to award-winning, complex apps and systems; influence the innovation of products used by millions globally; and work in a highly collaborative, results-oriented team environment.

**Responsibilities**

*Coding & Artificial Intelligence (AI)-Augmented Development*

* Work in a Full-stack capacity across JavaScript (Node, React, Next.js) and Java (Spring Boot)
* Leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) coding assistants and agentic tools to scaffold code, optimize logic, and accelerate the delivery of robust features
* Write clean, concise, modular code that is easily testable, taking full ownership and accountability for reviewing and refining any Artificial Intelligence (AI)-generated code
* Utilize Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to assist in writing comprehensive unit and integration tests, ensuring high code quality and coverage

*Collaboration & Modern Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)*

* Participate in a modern, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enhanced agile environment
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle (requirements gathering, designing, building, testing, and maintenance), utilizing agentic tools to streamline documentation and technical planning
* Participate in code reviews with other team members, critically evaluating human-written and Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted code for security, performance, and architectural alignment

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in a related field (Computer Science, Computer Engineering)
* 0-2 years of experience in Java and the Spring Boot framework
* Experience with front-end web development
* Understanding of unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
* Understanding of modern agile processes, including continuous delivery, automated testing, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted workflows
* Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI) coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codeium) and an aptitude for prompt-driven development

*Preferred Experience*

* Experience with front-end technologies including React
* Experience with back-end technologies including Spring and Node
* Experience with HyperText Markup Language (HTML) or Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) layouts
* Experience using Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to aid in debugging, code scaffolding, or generating test coverage
* Experience with GraphQL and data federation
* Experience working with cloud-native tooling such as Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
* Experience contributing to open source projects
* Experience with public cloud providers such as Google Cloud
* Experience with content delivery networks such as Cloudflare, Fastly
* Familiarity with building or integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
* A baseball fan or sports enthusiast

**Pay Range:** $40.00 - $55.00 per hour

The actual offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your work experience, education, skills, and any other factors MLB considers relevant to the hiring decision.

**Why MLB?**

Major League Baseball (MLB) is the most historic of the major professional sports leagues in the United States and Canada. Employees love working at MLB because of the culture of growth, teamwork, and professionalism. Employees who are most successful at MLB take initiative, know how to identify problems and provide solutions, and always put the Team first. For those ready to step up to the plate and join the major leagues, MLB takes the same approach as teams do with their players: empowering our "workforce athletes" to be at their best by engineering experiences that put employees in the best position to succeed. Major League Baseball is looking for candidates who are passionate about growing America's pastime to best serve its fans for decades to come.

Madhive is the leading independent and fully customizable operating system built to help local media professionals build profitable, differentiated, and efficient businesses. Madhive empowers sales teams to extend their reach into streaming and connects local advertisers with the communities they serve. Madhive’s platform provides the unique ability to reach local audiences at national scale, with premium supply partnerships and end-to-end tools for planning, targeting, and measuring full-funnel campaign outcomes. Powering campaigns for over 30,000 small and medium businesses per day, Madhive is driving the evolution of local media.

**Software Engineer, Financial Systems (IC3)**

Madhive is hiring a Software Engineer to join our Financial Systems Engineering team. We’re building TallyIQ, Madhive’s internal finance application, giving Finance, Accounting, and Revenue Operations one place to manage invoicing, adjustments, approvals, reconciliation, and financial reporting. The application also includes financial analytics and decision-support tools, with opportunities to develop AI-powered predictive and prescriptive analytics.

The work spans user interfaces, APIs, backend services, and financial business logic, supported by integrations with our proprietary advertising platform, NetSuite, Salesforce, and BigQuery.

You’ll report to the Senior Software Engineering Manager for Financial Systems Engineering and work closely with Finance, Revenue Operations, and Product.

You’ll help determine what we build next. Working alongside your manager and Product, you’ll meet with Finance and Accounting stakeholders, including the CFO, to understand their challenges, identify opportunities, and turn those needs into application features. The roadmap will continue to evolve as we learn where better software can make the biggest difference.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to grow. You’ll ship features and take increasing ownership with support from your team. Accounting or finance knowledge is strongly preferred, along with curiosity, sound engineering judgment, and an interest in understanding the business behind the software.

This role is based out of our New York City headquarters at 225 Broadway. We operate on a hybrid model, and the ideal candidate will work from the NYC office 3 days per week as needed for team collaboration, close cycles, and planning sessions.

* Build application features for invoice generation and previews, credits and approvals, configurable templates, reconciliation, and financial analysis
* Develop APIs and backend services in Go and Python on Google Cloud, with opportunities to contribute to the React and TypeScript frontend
* Work directly with Finance and Accounting stakeholders, including finance leadership, to understand their processes, uncover unmet needs, and evaluate potential solutions
* Help shape and prioritize the application roadmap with your manager and Product, then carry defined features from discovery through implementation, release, and ongoing improvement
* Contribute to financial analytics and decision-support capabilities, including exploring AI-powered predictive and prescriptive analytics and finance workflow automation
* Build and maintain integrations with our proprietary platform, NetSuite, Salesforce, and BigQuery
* Build permissions, validation, tests, error handling, and audit trails that keep financial data accurate and support appropriate human oversight
* Use feedback from the people working in the application to improve its usability, reliability, and business value

**Who You Are**

* An early-career software engineer with 0–4 years of professional experience; recent graduates with substantial project, internship, or other hands-on building experience are welcome
* Comfortable programming in Go, Python, or a similar backend language, and working with SQL
* Able to demonstrate your engineering skills through professional work, internships, open-source contributions, or substantial projects
* Accounting or finance knowledge is strongly preferred, whether gained through coursework, a prior role, or practical experience with financial processes and analysis
* Interested in understanding how people work, asking thoughtful questions, and connecting engineering decisions to business needs
* Careful about correctness: you validate assumptions, test edge cases, and investigate unexpected results
* Proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working through ambiguity with support from teammates
* Ready to take ownership of well-defined work and grow toward broader responsibility
* Hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or have equivalent hands-on engineering experience
* NYC-based or willing to relocate

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building web applications with React and TypeScript
* Experience with financial analytics, data modeling, or data pipelines
* Familiarity with NetSuite, Salesforce, or ERP integrations
* Experience with Google Cloud, including Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, or BigQuery
* Experience building with LLMs, tool calling, predictive modeling, or AI-assisted workflows

* Contribute to the application’s financial analytics and AI-assisted capabilities
* Build trust with business partners by understanding their needs, investigating discrepancies, and following through on issues

Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**Job Background / Overview**

The IRC is actively investing in enterprise AI to improve the speed, quality, and scale of its programs and operations.
